notes.title: Share Your Code/Creations In Pastopia!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Walkers,

Pastopia opens up a whole new world where your imagination knows no limits, so [b]be proud of your creations and share it to the world![/b] [b]Drop your best screenshots or videos of the structures[/b] you’ve made so far in the community and flex it off ᕙ( ˵ •̀ ᴗ - ˵ )ᕗ ✧

To give you some inspiration, here are some creations that the devs have come up with in-game!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45241874/80a589b8d8629603fdf564555ec8cd37f182c217.png"][/img][/p][p]The devs are super pumped to see your wildest creations![/p][p]
We hope you’ve been having fun playing Pastopia during this Next Fest season - and if you haven’t played it yet, it’s not too late to download the free demo now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45241874/604af1ed994303784e933b85ee0bcc93ab9820cf.png"][/img][/p][p]
Love, 
Pastopia Dev Team

[/p]

notes.title: Pastopia Next Fest Demo: Play Now!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45241874/8ecf3a73b4abf7092b26a04c8c138348b2a24eb5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Dear Walkers,

Steam Next Fest is finally here, and [b]Pastopia[/b] is honoured to be apart of this month's edition! (insert my_longest_yeah_boy_ever.mp4)

From [b]June 9th to June 16th[/b], dive into the world of Pastopia and discover a glimpse of what entails in the Memory Walker's journey to restore forgotten Memory Fragments scattered across the mystical lands.

[b]What’s in the Demo?[/b][/p][p]Our Next Fest demo offers a [b]handpicked slice[/b] of the full game, such as:
👾 [b]Puzzle-solving using block-coding & scripting[/b] – Try out mechanics you won’t see anywhere else!
👾 [b]Creating shapes using the codes you make[/b] – Endless creativity is at your fingertips!
👾 [b]Exploring the vibrant world of Pastopia - [/b]Unlock the story of Pastopia from the Temple Grounds to Thala Henge!

And as always, we're always open for feedback/comments/suggestions/bug reports - so send them to this [url="https://forms.gle/JBKoaYLPzNi5jKva8"]Google Form[/url] here! (We're ready to read them all!!!)

We're also grateful to be apart of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/southeastasiangamesshowcase"]Southeast Asia Games Showcase[/url] happening from [b]June 6th to June 20th[/b], which you should definitely check out along with other amazingly curated games from the SEA region![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you have a great time playing all types of games this Next Fest, and we hope Pastopia is one of them!   [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45241874/604af1ed994303784e933b85ee0bcc93ab9820cf.png"][/img][/p][p]Love, Pastopia Dev Team <3[/p]

notes.title: Pastopia Demo Version Is Live! 📢
notes.content:
Dear Walkers,

After two years of development, we’re thrilled (jumping on all fours like an excited puppy!!!) to release the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384560/Pastopia_Demo/]Demo Version[/url] of Pastopia in conjunction with this June’s Steam Next Fest! 

If you’ve followed us since the days we were on itch.io or have visited us at various game events, we sincerely can’t thank you enough for supporting us throughout this journey. 

We’re always looking for ways to make Pastopia better, so shoot us a message in our [url=https://forms.gle/p6cANMy3CfNJwHt7A]Google Forms[/url] if you encounter any issues, bugs, or just want to hurl us gems of feedback. We’d love to know what you think about the game! (Your insights would mean the world to us ദ്ദി ꒦ິ꒳꒦ິ )✧)

We hope Pastopia brings your creativity to new heights and that you have lots of fun exploring and coding! <3

The forgotten memories of Pastopia await you!
